gloss: deputy department head; assistant manager; vice-captain (of a club)

definitions.gloss: deputy department head; assistant manager; vice-captain (of a club)
definitions.explanation: The person who supports and acts as deputy to a {部長|ぶちょう} — a department head in a company, or the captain of a school or university club. Responsibilities typically include deputizing for the head when absent and handling day-to-day coordination within the unit.

examples.japanese: {副部長|ふくぶちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{選|えら}ばれた→選ぶ：00835_erabu⟧。
examples.english: I was chosen as deputy department head.

examples.japanese: ⟦{営業|えいぎょう}{部|ぶ}→営業部：19381_eigyoubu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{副部長|ふくぶちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{会議|かいぎ}→会議：00710_kaigi⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{仕切|しき}った→仕切る：04666_shikiru⟧。
examples.english: The deputy manager of the sales department ran the meeting.

examples.japanese: ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{出張|しゅっちょう}→出張：01094_shucchou⟧⟦{中|ちゅう}→〜中：09840_chuu⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧{副部長|ふくぶちょう}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{代|か}わり→代わり：01296_kawari⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{判断|はんだん}する→判断する：06062_handansuru⟧。
examples.english: While the department head is on a business trip, the deputy makes decisions in his place.

notes:
Formed with the prefix ⟦{副|ふく}→副〜：03965_fuku⟧- ('vice-; assistant; deputy') attached to ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧ ('department head; club captain'). The same pattern produces {副社長|ふくしゃちょう} ('vice president') and ⟦{副会長|ふくかいちょう}→副会長：20469_fukukaichou⟧ ('vice chair').

USAGE:
- In corporate contexts: the second-in-command of a department (⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧), ranking below the ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧ and above section chiefs (⟦{課長|かちょう}→課長：01075_kachou⟧).
- In school/club contexts: the vice-captain of a school club (also called ⟦{部|ぶ}→〜部：00440_bu⟧), supporting the student-elected ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧.
- Often abbreviated to ⟦{副|ふく}→副〜：03965_fuku⟧ within the organization when context is clear: 「⟦{副|ふく}→副〜：03965_fuku⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦やらせる→やる：02980_yaru⟧」('have the deputy do it').

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {副部長|ふくぶちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{任命|にんめい}→任命：09764_ninmei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to appoint as deputy head
- {副部長|ふくぶちょう}⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{昇進|しょうしん}→昇進：04553_shoushin⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to be promoted to deputy head
- {副部長|ふくぶちょう}{職|しょく}: the position of deputy head
- {副部長|ふくぶちょう}{代理|だいり}: acting deputy head

SIMILAR WORDS:
- ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧: department head; club captain — the superior whom the {副部長|ふくぶちょう} supports.
- ⟦{次長|じちょう}→次長：17780_jichou⟧: deputy director; assistant manager — a similar-rank position, often more senior in large organizations; typically used one level up from {副部長|ふくぶちょう}.
- ⟦{課長|かちょう}→課長：01075_kachou⟧: section chief — the rank below ⟦{部長|ぶちょう}→部長：01017_buchou⟧ in the standard corporate hierarchy.
- ⟦{副会長|ふくかいちょう}→副会長：20469_fukukaichou⟧: vice chair; vice president (of a society) — same ⟦{副|ふく}→副〜：03965_fuku⟧- prefix applied to ⟦{会長|かいちょう}→会長：11610_kaichou⟧.
- {副社長|ふくしゃちょう}: vice president (of a company) — senior corporate officer, not a department-level role.
